title: Graphs and data analysis; SI units and prefixes
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for OCR A-level (A) Physics (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: MS03-1#t3 term and clue written for the game; MS01-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; MS03-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; MS01-1#t2 term and clue written for the game. Questions: MS01-1#N.5, MS03-1#N.15, MS01-1#N.7, MS01-1#N.11a, MS01-1#N.12.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: y-intercept
items.clue: Value on the vertical axis where x = 0.

items.label: Newton
items.clue: Name for kg m s⁻², from force = mass × acceleration.

items.label: Tangent
items.clue: Drawn on a curve when its slope at one place is needed.

items.label: Derived unit
items.clue: One obtained from a defining equation, such as m s⁻¹ for velocity.

questions.stem: A spring's stiffness is its spring constant: the force needed per unit change in its length. What is the unit of the spring constant in base units?
questions.explanation: Spring constant = force ÷ change in length: kg m s⁻² ÷ m = kg s⁻². This is the same unit as N m⁻¹.

questions.stem: A best-fit line has gradient 2.50. The steepest line through all the error bars has gradient 2.65 (same units). What is the percentage uncertainty in the gradient?
The cross-sectional area of a wire is 0.50 mm². What is this area in m²?
Which equation cannot be correct, because it is not homogeneous? (s displacement, u and v velocities, a acceleration, t time)
questions.explanation: v² and u² are in m² s⁻², but 2at is in m s⁻¹. Terms with different units cannot be added, so this equation must be wrong.

questions.stem: Pressure is force ÷ area, and its unit is the pascal (Pa). What is the pascal in base units?
questions.explanation: Pa = N m⁻² = kg m s⁻² × m⁻² = kg m⁻¹ s⁻².
